environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes rule group reference statement to 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' (priority 1, action BLOCK) which contains the JavaDeserializationRCE rule and Log4JRCE rule, plus a custom rule (priority 2) with a RegexPatternSet match condition on the request body field targeting patterns matching template injection signatures including '${' followed by script-like content (pattern: '\$\{[^}]*(Runtime|exec|eval|Process|Script|nashorn|getEngine)[^}]*\}'). Additionally, the SQS queue resource policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to only the ECS task execution role ARN, preventing direct queue injection. The ALB listener forwards only to the target group after WAF evaluation passes.

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.iam: ECS task role with scoped SQS permissions
